entries.title: Psalms 95:1
segments: ¶O come, let us make songs to the Lord; sending up glad voices to the Rock of our salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 95:2
segments: Let us come before his face with praises; and make melody with holy songs.

entries.title: Psalms 95:3
segments: For the Lord is a great God, and a great King over all gods.

entries.title: Psalms 95:4
segments: The deep places of the earth are in his hand; and the tops of the mountains are his.

entries.title: Psalms 95:5
segments: The sea is his, and he made it; and the dry land was formed by his hands.

entries.title: Psalms 95:6
segments: O come, let us give worship, falling down on our knees before the Lord our Maker.

entries.title: Psalms 95:7
segments: ¶For he is our God; and we are the people to whom he gives food, and the sheep of his flock. Today, if you would only give ear to his voice!

entries.title: Psalms 95:8
segments: Let not your hearts be hard, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the waste land;

entries.title: Psalms 95:9
segments: When your fathers put me to the test and saw my power and my work.

entries.title: Psalms 95:10
segments: For forty years I was angry with this generation, and said, They are a people whose hearts are turned away from me, for they have no knowledge of my ways;

entries.title: Psalms 95:11
segments: And I made an oath in my wrath, that they might not come into my place of rest.
